token.description: Opaque bearer token. Stored server-side only as a SHA-256 hash.

workspaceRoot.description: Canonical absolute root of the current Workspace binding. Owner-only; null when this Chat has no binding.

snippet.description: Excerpt from the first matching user/assistant message; null for a title-only match.

workspaceRoot.description: Canonical absolute root of the current Workspace binding. Owner-only; null when this Chat has no binding.

beforeTokens.description: The checkpoint summarization call's input token count.

afterTokens.description: The checkpoint summarization call's output token count.

effort.description: The checkpoint summarization call's reasoning effort.

absorbedThroughSeq.description: The last Chat-local message sequence absorbed by this checkpoint.

absorbedMessageCount.description: User and assistant rows absorbed by this checkpoint.

summary.description: The checkpoint summary from its persisted payload.

messageId.description: The user message this Run executes.

followUpAction.description: The follow-up action that started this Run, or null for a chat send.

effort.description: The effort the Run executes with; null sends no effort.

error.description: The terminal message of a failed or expired Run, the same text its stream error frame carries; null for any other Run or none recorded.

latestRun.description: The Chat's newest Run; null when the Chat has no Run.

mediaType.description: Ignored: the stored part carries the media's own type.

url.description: A `media://<id>` locator of media the sender owns.

filename.description: Ignored: the stored part carries the media's own name.

parts.description: At most 50 text parts and 10 file parts, in order; at least one part.

modelId.description: Opaque llame model id selected for this turn.

effort.description: Reasoning effort for this turn. Must be one of the selected model's `reasoning.effortLevels[].value`; omit to use its `defaultEffort`. Matched byte-exactly — not case-folded.

permissionMode.description: Permission mode for this turn; omit for default.

action.description: Resume the completed steps of the latest Run and request its next step.

permissionMode.description: Permission mode for this Run; omit for default.

visibility.description: Sharing: 'public' exposes a read-only link at /shared/:id; 'private' revokes it.

projectId.description: File the chat into this project. Pass null to unfile; omit to leave unchanged.

archived.description: Archive (true) or unarchive (false) the chat. Omit or send null to leave unchanged.

fromMessageId.description: Copy up to (and including) this message. Omit to fork the whole conversation.

name.description: Worktree name; becomes the `llame/<name>` branch unless it carries a `/`.

baseRef.description: Commit, branch, or tag the new worktree branches from.

parts.description: At most 50 text parts and 10 file parts, in order; at least one part.

modelId.description: Opaque llame model id selected for this turn.

effort.description: Reasoning effort for this turn. Must be one of the selected model's `reasoning.effortLevels[].value`; omit to use its `defaultEffort`.

permissionMode.description: Permission mode the Workspace step evaluates; omit for `default`.

message.description: The bounded, redacted git standard error, when there is one.

leftDirectory.description: The directory an `outcome_unknown` can leave behind.

reference.description: The bounded clause reference, when one matched.

status.description: Online when the last successful contact is inside the inactivity window and after the last failure.

lastSeenAt.description: When the hub last completed a handshake with this Machine.

failureReason.description: Why the last contact attempt failed, when one did.

hubProtocolVersion.description: The protocol version the hub speaks.

daemonProtocolVersion.description: The protocol version the daemon reported, once known.

roots.description: The Machine's registered roots; addressing, not isolation.

nextCursor.description: The `before` of the next page; null on the last page.

cacheWrite.description: Declared cache-write (cache-creation) rate. Absent means the operator declared none: cache-write tokens are then billed at `input`. Only the declared rate is published — never the resolved fallback.

value.description: Opaque provider-native effort token. Matched byte-exactly on chat send; never a display string.

label.description: Operator-authored display label. Absent when the config used a bare string. Never invented from `value`.

effortLevels.description: Effort levels this model accepts, in the order a client presents them. Each item has a `value` (opaque provider-native identifier) and an optional operator `label`. Derive no meaning or magnitude from either string, and do not assume a value means the same thing on another model. Order is the only scale.

defaultEffort.description: The level value applied when a chat send omits `effort`. Always one of `effortLevels[].value`.

cacheInvalidatedByEffortChange.description: Whether CHANGING effort between turns invalidates this model's provider-side prompt cache — not whether effort does. Operator-declared, because the behavior is model-specific and partly undocumented. Advisory metadata for warning a user before a costly prefix re-read; it does not affect execution.

input.description: Input modalities this model accepts, in the operator-declared order. Always present and always contains `text`; `["text"]` when the operator declared none. Never inferred from the model id or provider.

reasoning.description: Present only when the operator declared an effort vocabulary for this model. Absent means the model accepts no `effort` on a chat send.

description.description: What this project is for. Omit or pass null for none.
What this project is for. Pass null to clear it; omit to leave unchanged.

archived.description: Archive (true) or unarchive (false) the project. Omit to leave unchanged.

defaultExecutorId.description: Executor id a chat start on this project prefers. Pass null to clear it; omit to leave it unchanged.

updatedAt.description: The time of the last write; the newest row wins.

alias.description: The project's own label for the repository. Defaults to the repository display name.

isPrimary.description: Make this the project primary link, clearing any previous one.
True makes this the project primary link and clears the previous one; false clears this link.

isolationReason.description: project_policy when the link policy decides, clone_in_use when another open chat holds the checkout, no_link when no link resolved.

isolationChats.description: How many open chats already bind the resolved checkout; zero unless the reason is clone_in_use.

effort.description: Reasoning effort this run executed at, resolved when the run was accepted. Absent when the run carried none. An opaque provider token — a receipt of what ran, never recomputed from current configuration.

permissionMode.description: Accepted permission mode for this run.

systemPrompt.description: Complete effective system prompt rendered for this attempt.

promptHash.description: Hash of the rendered system prompt.

modelId.description: Public llame model id selected for this run.

effort.description: Reasoning effort this run executed at, resolved when the run was accepted. Absent when the run carried none.

permissionMode.description: Accepted permission mode for this run.

activeAttemptId.description: Active execution attempt identity, if any.

completedAttemptId.description: Completed (winning) attempt identity, if the run completed successfully.

state.description: Resolution state: pending (queued, no attempt prepared yet), prepared (at least one attempt has a receipt), or not_produced (terminal without any receipt).

receipts.description: Ordered list of system-prompt receipts, one per execution attempt that reached prompt preparation. Earliest first.

proactive.description: Whether the package may be selected proactively rather than only by explicit mention.

available.description: False when discovery could not run to completion; items is then empty and diagnostics explains why.

preferredName.description: What the assistant should call you. Null clears it.

about.description: Role, work context, and languages, as prose. Null clears it. Counts against every request for you, so a maxed-out value is a material share of a small model context window.

responsePreferences.description: How answers should be delivered. Null clears it. These are delivery preferences of bounded authority: they cannot grant tools, relax tool authorization, or override safety constraints.

enabled.description: Master switch over all per-user prompt context. Turning it off also stops account identity, not just authored text.

shareAccountIdentity.description: Send your account display name and email address to the model provider the operator has configured — which in a multi-user instance may be a third party with no relationship to you. Defaults to false, and applies only where the configured prompt references those values.

shareRecentChats.description: Share titles and opening excerpts from your other chats with the model provider configured by the operator, which on a multi-user instance may be a third party with no relationship to you. Enabling is retroactive over your whole existing corpus, including chats and opening excerpts created long before opt-in. Disabling is not retroactive: it stops new baselines, re-bakes, and appends, but chats with an existing baseline keep sending it. Deleting a chat is not erasure: its title and excerpt survive in other chats' already-bound prompts, persisted appends, and receipts already issued. Defaults to false.

displayName.description: One path segment, without "/" or a NUL byte.

remote.description: The origin remote. Stored normalized; omit for a repository whose clone has no origin.
Pass null to clear the canonical remote.

path.description: An absolute local path or a configured `machine://` locator.

repositoryId.description: Selects an existing repository of this owner.

remote.description: A remote that selects an existing repository of this owner. The inspected origin decides.

executorId.description: The local executor id, or machine:<name>.

branch.description: Null for a detached HEAD registration or adoption.

chatIds.description: The ids of this owner's chats whose Workspace root equals path.

leaseChatId.description: The chat whose lease records this worktree, when one does.

worktreeBase.description: The placement base of new worktrees: an absolute host path, or a machine:// locator of this checkout’s own Machine.

memberCount.description: Number of membership rows directly on this unit (org-memberships read enrichment, D3). Scoped by the same visibility as the roster: a unit visible only via the creator-bootstrap edge may transiently read 0.

directRole.description: The caller's own DIRECT role on this unit (not inherited from an ancestor); null when they hold no direct membership here. Inherited role is derivable client-side from the path.

settings.description: Opaque node-scoped settings (SPEC §7.2); replaces the whole object. Interpretation is the config resolver’s job (#46).

parentId.description: Move under this parent id. Explicit null promotes the unit to root. Omit to leave the unit where it is.

inherited.description: True when the role comes from an ancestor, not the unit itself.
